asset.name: ScrollRestoration
asset.description: The service restoring or resetting scroll position based on route, history action, content identity, and explicit user intent, rather than always jumping to the top.

requires.reason: Position history is scoped to the application instance.

rationale: Modelled as a service in the navigation domain rather than a navigation surface, which is the clearest demonstration that kind and domain are orthogonal: it ranks with runtime services so a component may depend on it.
